question: Can a deterministic selector preserve the frozen 80/10 split, 22500 clusters, role quotas and full event coverage while representing every tunnel with at most 10m same-tunnel candidate-to-selected arc distance?
method: Per world, solve a sparse binary MILP with exact role quotas, exact length-proportional per-tunnel quotas, junction/terminal event constraints and <=10m same-tunnel coverage; solve twice for deterministic replay. Read graph/splines and the V1 cluster manifest only; zero mesh load, raycast, data export or training.

approval.scope: One zero-ray selector-V2 feasibility implementation and formal audit preserving 80/10 worlds, 22500 clusters, role quotas and event coverage; no data re-export or training.
